content.title: How to watch stream and listen to Texas AM basketball vs Houston in second round of NCAA Tournament
content.text: Texas A&M is looking to keep alive what has already been an unexpectedly impressive first season under head coach Bucky McMillan. After defeating Saint Mary's, 63-50, in the first round of the NCAA Tournament on Thursday, A&M will take on Houston at 5:10 p.m. Saturday at the Paycom Center in Oklahoma City. The details on how to watch, stream and listen to the game between the No. 10 seed Aggies (22-11) and the No. 2 seed Cougars (29-6) can be found later in this article.A&M didn't enter the postseason playing its best basketball, losing seven of its previous 11 games, including three of its last five. Against the Gaels, however, the Aggies turned things around despite not having an efficient performance shooting beyond the arc (34.8%). Their defensive intensity was the story of their Round of 64 contest, as they recorded 12 steals and forced 18 turnovers. They'll look to keep that up against a Houston team that averages 77.2 points per game on the season.GigEm247 will cover the matchup in Oklahoma City, offering live updates throughout the game and analysis following the final result. The winner would play next week in the Sweet 16 against the team that advanced from the Saturday game between No. 3 seed Illinois and No. 11 seed VCU. No. 2 seed Houston Cougars (29-6) vs. No. 10 seed Texas A&M Aggies (22-11)When: Saturday, March 21, 5:10 p.m. CDT.Where: Paycom Center (capacity for basketball: 18,203); Oklahoma City.TV: TNT. Brandon Gaudin (play-by-play), Chris Webber (color commentary), and Andy Katz (sideline reporter) will be on the call, as was the case for the Saint Mary's game. Streaming: Available HERE via ncaa.com. Radio: Texas A&M Radio Network. It will be carried locally on 1620 AM/94.5 FM and worldwide on the 12th Man mobile app. Andrew Monaco (play-by-play) and John Thornton (color commentary) will provide coverage. Westwood One will carry the national radio call. That call can be found on SiriusXM channel 202.Betting: The Aggies are 10.5-point underdogs against the Cougars, per BetOnline Sportsbook. The over/under scoring total is set at 142.5.What A&M head coach Bucky McMillan said about Houston on Friday: "Well, they look like five Tyrannosaurus Rexes out there. They're long, big, athletic, well-coached, and tough. But other than that, not many. Ball screen defense is good. One-on-one defense is good. Post defense is good. They rebound really well. Bring back three starters from their Final Four team last year. So got experience. You know what they're doing and have been through a tough league."What McMillan said about the Cougars' slower pace and few turnovers committed: "Well, they got good guard play. At the end of the day, if you got good guards, that helps you handle the basketball, they have clarity in what they do, they're tough. "Challenges, obviously, how are you guaranteed to stop another team? You don't let them get a shot off, right? That means you do turn them over. I mean, they're strong. They're tough. That's just the way when you get deep in the tournament good guard play is. But you still got to be us. Everything McMillan said in his pregame press conference Friday can be found here.Series history: A&M has an extensive series history with nearby Houston. In the all-time series, the Cougars own a 54-32 advantage over the Aggies. A&M last played Houston in the second round of the 2024 NCAA Tournament, a game in which it almost knocked off the top-seeded Cougars. A&M lost, 100-95, in overtime. They Aggies have split the six games they've played against Houston this century. NCAA Tournament history: Through 18 appearances in the NCAA Tournament, A&M holds a 16-18 record. The Aggies have never made it to the Elite Eight round in program history. They previously reached the Sweet 16 six times.Bucky McMillan pregame press conference videoStay tuned to GigEm247 for more basketball coverage.
